subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
In the figure, silicon diode is carrying a constant 
current of 1 mA. When the temperature of the diode is 
20°C, VD is found to be 700 mV. If the temperature 
rises to 40°C, VD becomes approx equal to 
 
 
(a) 740 mV 
(b) 650 mV 
 
(c) 680 mV 
(d) 700 mV
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-02 (Analog Electronics Practice Sheet 02).
